newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB plans no council meeting today.
newsitem.headline: SNB plans no council meeting today.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank's (SNB) three-man governing council will not hold a meeting today, an SNB spokesman said.
The council usually holds a meeting each week on Thursday.
The SNB spokesman gave no reason for today's decision not to hold a meeting.
At its September 26 meeting, the SNB governing council cut its discount rate by 50 basis points to 1.0 percent. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
